summary: You finish the base of Module 12: a request id across both services, a requests table with one row per request (latency, tokens, cost, outcome), about 20 requests through the gateway, and one query for the five dashboard numbers, each defined before it is shown and with what it hides: the average hides a cold start, a refusal counts as a success, the cost has estimated tokens and example prices.
goal: Every question has latency, tokens and cost.

items.text: Check that one request shows the same id in both logs
Add the metrics table and store, with an in-memory fake for tests
Add the token estimate: 0 before the writer, NULL when not measured
Send about 20 requests through the gateway including a refusal and a failure
Write dashboard.sql, define each number, and say what each one hides
Write the README section on finding one request and on what is an estimate
